# Ledger catalog
<!-- Generated by `python -m mdept.index`. Do not edit. Run: make regen -->

> Every entry of both ledgers, released and unreleased, one line each: `ID status: title | aka informal names | the Statement's opening`. Refuted and merged entries stay listed: they are what stops a statement being stipulated twice.
> `python -m mdept.query "<your own words>"` ranks entries against a question; `python -m mdept.query MD_0007` prints one entry's card (statement, hypotheses, Lean name, links, citations).
> Cite an entry by its ID. A line citing a refuted entry carries `refuted`; a line citing a conjectured or open entry carries one of `pending`, `conjectured`, `open`.

## toy

- MD_0001 proven-formal: Adding zero on the naturals changes nothing | \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, n + 0 = n
- MD_0002 refuted: Every integer exceeds its own square | \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, n^2 > n
- MD_0003 cited: The toy source theorem taken as it stands | Theorem 1.1 of the toy source, as stated there.
- MD_0004 conjectured: A stipulation nobody has worked yet | \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, n \le 2^n
- MD_0005 conjectured: The toy bound on the naturals | \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, n \le 2^n
- MD_0006 open: The strict form of the toy bound | \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, n < 2^n
- MD_0007 proven-formal: Adding zero on the left changes nothing | \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, 0 + n = n
